subject: Literature
subcategory: Classic Novels That Changed the World
title: On the Road and the Beat Generation
description: A short lesson to help you apply On the Road and the Beat Generation.

hook.text: Jack Kerouac typed his novel on a single one-hundred-twenty-foot scroll of paper in just three weeks.

buildup.text: On the Road chronicled frantic road trips across America fueled by jazz, poetry, and restless freedom.

discovery.text: Published in 1957, it became the manifesto of the Beat Generation and a bible for counterculture youth.

twist.text: Critics called it undisciplined typing, not writing, but young readers treated it as a liberation manual.

climax.text: On the Road inspired the hippie movement, punk rock, and generations of artists who rejected conformity.

punchline.text: Three weeks of typing became a generation's anthem.

quiz.question: How did Jack Kerouac write On the Road?
options: Over ten years with careful revisions
On a single scroll of paper in about three weeks
By dictating to a secretary while traveling
